The note says the ride was for early morning booth setup at Productronica, but states none of the enumerated justifications: the pickup and drop-off are a hotel and a trade-fair ground, not an airport or long-distance rail station; the receipt time 08:42 is not after 21:00 or before 06:00; and there is no mention of bulky presentation displays or heavy client equipment, a shared vehicle, or consecutive offsite meetings. Per Chapter 2, where a required note fact is missing Finance applies the less favorable branch, so the fare is reimbursed only up to the €25.00 threshold and the €21.20 excess is deducted.
